identity.name: AWS SSM Agent Network Connection via PowerShell
identity.summary: An attacker uses AWS SSM Agent to execute PowerShell commands and establish a network connection to a C2 server. Cortex should detect the suspicious network activity originating from the SSM agent pro
identity.description: An attacker uses AWS SSM Agent to execute PowerShell commands and establish a network connection to a C2 server. Cortex should detect the suspicious network activity originating from the SSM agent process.

expected_artifacts.description: PowerShell process started by SSM agent

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suspicious Network Connection from SSM Agent
biocs.description: Detects outbound network connections initiated by the SSM agent process
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'ssmagent.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100'
| filter dst_port = 80

abiocs.name: SSM Agent PowerShell Execution
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where SSM agent spawns PowerShell with suspicious command line arguments
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'ssmagent.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '-NoP -W Hidden -Exec Bypass'

xql_queries.name: Network Connection from SSM Agent

| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'ssmagent.exe'

| filter dst_port = 80
